__NOTOC__ The Regal Dottyback is a fish that can be caught in Khaz Algar. These fish are sought by anglers for their use in catching the elusive Queen's Lurefish, a critical ingredient for The Sushi Special, a recipe in which the Dottyback is also used. They are also extremely useful for gathering fresh fillets for other recipes, as their rarity means they often generate more fillets than other fish. Dottyback can be caught in open water, though they sometimes congregate in rare Royal Ripples. Despite what the tooltip says, throwing them back will only extend the buff up to 5 minutes.
